name: fibroblast growth factor receptor substrate 2
pathways: fibroblast growth factor receptor signaling pathway

function.text: FRS2 encodes fibroblast growth factor receptor substrate 2. Annotated molecular activities include phosphatase activator activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase adaptor activity. It participates in G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway and fibroblast growth factor receptor signaling pathway.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
